reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the redline is byte-identical to the original paragraphs with no comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

Cited text supports the preferred position: Section 8.3 termination is event-driven with no exit payment, and Section 7.5(c) places transition expenses on the resigning/terminated Servicer (counterparty), so no Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalty exists.

The two noted items are correctly characterised as non-deviations: the $150,000/Additional Successor Servicer Fee is compensation to a third-party replacement servicer paid from Collections rather than a liquidated amount owed to the counterparty, and Make-Whole Payments arise from a voluntary Optional Redemption, i.e. noteholder prepayment economics, not a penalty imposed on us.
Detection guidance is respected — obligations running against the Servicer/Marketing Agent benefit our side and are properly left unflagged.
